note: 1 = neighbour is same terrain. Corner bit only meaningful when both adjacent sides are also same-terrain (Godot 47-case reduction; verified). gid = row*cols + col + 1. Use scripts/ninja_autotile.py to paint a terrain grid. Regenerate derived materials with scripts/gen_autotile_masks.py; then scripts/gen_tileset_library.py to refresh tiled/*.tsj wangsets.
coverage: VERIFIED wangset/mask tables in this file: TilesetFloor 8×47-blob (Godot); TilesetWallSimple 4 palettes; TilesetInteriorFloor dark_cobble + tan_plank + cream/orange brick frames + gold/green ornate; TilesetHole; TilesetWater×4; TilesetFloorB cloud+island; TilesetField×5; tileset_bed stone. NOT wangsets (modular/hand-place kits — see tilesets.json): Pipes, Desert wall-kit, Relief cliffs.

dirt_grass.desc: brown dirt over green grass (canonical Godot reference)

dirt_grass_dark.desc: darker dirt, thicker green grass border

pink_sand.desc: light-pink sand over pink (palette-swap of tan)

cream_wall.desc: cream walled-room frame. Smooth mid-edges (3,0)/(3,4)/(0,1)/(4,1); door jambs (1,0)/(2,0)/(1,4)/(2,4); corners at 0/4. WALL=terrain, room=hole; oob=terrain for map-edge boxes.

orange_wall.desc: orange walled-room frame. Smooth mid-edges (3,0)/(3,4)/(0,1)/(4,1); door jambs (1,0)/(2,0)/(1,4)/(2,4); corners at 0/4. WALL=terrain, room=hole; oob=terrain for map-edge boxes.

brown_wall.desc: brown/dark walled-room frame. Smooth mid-edges (3,0)/(3,4)/(0,1)/(4,1); door jambs (1,0)/(2,0)/(1,4)/(2,4); corners at 0/4. WALL=terrain, room=hole; oob=terrain for map-edge boxes.

green_wall.desc: green walled-room frame. Smooth mid-edges (3,0)/(3,4)/(0,1)/(4,1); door jambs (1,0)/(2,0)/(1,4)/(2,4); corners at 0/4. WALL=terrain, room=hole; oob=terrain for map-edge boxes.

dark_cobble.desc: dark cobblestone 3x3 island (cols 11-13 rows 12-14, pixel-verified). Fill uses the seamless 2x2 running-bond at (16-17,13-14) (parity-selected). Col 14 = vertical strip, row 15 = horizontal strip — not part of the 3x3.

tan_plank.desc: tan plank/tile floor 3×3 island at cols 0-2 rows 12-14; cols 3+ are fill/scatter variants.

cream_brick.desc: cream/tan brick large walled-room frame (cols 4-8 rows 0-4). Masks transferred from WallSimple cream_wall (smooth mids + door jambs). WALL=terrain, room=hole.

cream_brick_sm.desc: cream/tan brick compact 4×4 closed room frame (cols 0-3 rows 0-3). Smooth edges only.

orange_brick.desc: orange brick large walled-room frame (cols 4-8 rows 6-10). Same layout as cream_brick.

orange_brick_sm.desc: orange brick compact 4×4 closed room frame (cols 0-3 rows 6-9).

gold_ornate.desc: gold ornate carpet/medallion outer frame (cols 15-19 rows 0-3) + center fill. Paint rectangular rugs; decorative side motifs at col 20+ are hand-place.

green_ornate.desc: green ornate carpet/medallion outer frame (cols 15-19 rows 6-9) + center fill.

hole.desc: pit/hole 47-blob stamped from dirt_grass layout (cols 0-10 rows 0-3 + inner corners). Fill = dark void at (1,1)/(2,1). Decor row of Floor omitted.

sand_water.desc: sand/beach-edged water: 47-blob stamped from dirt_grass at origin [0, 0]. Fill = open water at (1,1)/(2,1).

grass_water.desc: grass-edged water: 47-blob stamped from dirt_grass at origin [0, 6]. Fill = open water at (1,7)/(2,7).

ice_water.desc: ice / frozen water: 47-blob stamped from dirt_grass at origin [13, 0]. Fill = open water at (14,1)/(15,1).

magic_water.desc: magic / mauve water (dirt-edged): 47-blob stamped from dirt_grass at origin [13, 6]. Fill = open water at (14,7)/(15,7).

cloud.desc: pale cloud 47-blob (cols 4-10). Stamped from dirt_grass; sheet is narrower so some right-column cases are absent. Fill at (5,1)/(6,1).

cloud_island.desc: compact cloud island at cols 0-2 rows 0-2 (plus thin-strip tiles hand-place separately).

orange_soil.desc: orange tilled soil / clay: rounded 3×3 island + solid fill tiles at (3,0)/(4,0).

spring_grass.desc: light yellow-green grass (spring): rounded 3×3 island + solid fill tiles at (3,3)/(4,3).

summer_grass.desc: dark green grass (summer): rounded 3×3 island + solid fill tiles at (3,6)/(4,6).

autumn_ground.desc: pink/salmon ground (autumn/cherry): rounded 3×3 island + solid fill tiles at (3,9)/(4,9).

field_snow.desc: off-white snow: rounded 3×3 island + solid fill tiles at (3,12)/(4,12).

stone_slab.desc: grey stone slab 3×3 at cols 0-2 rows 9-11; extra fill variants in cols 3-5.
